Auth.tagline: All your businesses in one panel
Auth.name: Name

Pages.generalDescription: Everything from all your workspaces, consolidated.
Pages.noMetricsDescription: Metrics show up once the workspace has sales, orders or projects.
Pages.noEventsDescription: Events show up once you start using the calendar.
Pages.noComparisonDescription: The comparison between workspaces shows up once there are sales.
Pages.plannedIn: It's built in Phase {phase} of the plan: {name}.

NotFound.title: We couldn't find this page
NotFound.description: It may not exist or you may not have access to it.

Workspace.createDescription: It starts with the modules for its type; you can change them later in the settings.
Workspace.name: Name

typeHelp.BUSINESS: Products, customers, suppliers, price lists, orders, calculator and calendar.
typeHelp.PROJECTS: Customers, projects, quotes, documents and calendar.

Workspace.settingsDescription: The workspace's details, color and modules. Only the account Owner can change them.
Workspace.modulesDescription: Disabled modules disappear from the workspace menu. Their data isn't deleted.
Workspace.alwaysOn: Always on: it's the workspace page.
Workspace.archiveDescription: The workspace stops showing up on the home screen and in the menu, and its address returns 404. The data is kept.
Workspace.archiveConfirmBody: It will stop showing up for all its members.
Workspace.saveError: The changes couldn't be saved. Try again.

ModuleInfo.DASHBOARD: A board with the workspace's numbers: sales, margins, stock and what's pending, with widgets you'll be able to arrange.
ModuleInfo.PRODUCTS: Your catalog: products with variants, categories, and each variant's stock, cost and price.
ModuleInfo.CUSTOMERS: Your customers with their contact details, order history and what they owe you.
ModuleInfo.SUPPLIERS: The suppliers you buy from, with their details and what they sell you.
ModuleInfo.PRICE_LISTS: Price lists (wholesale, retail, resellers) built from each variant's cost.
ModuleInfo.CALCULATOR: Formulas and templates to calculate prices, margins and import costs.
ModuleInfo.MARKET_PRICES: The market price of your products, with automatic tracking and history.
ModuleInfo.ORDERS: Sales: orders with their items, payments and statuses, which reduce stock.
ModuleInfo.PURCHASES: Purchases and imports that add stock and update each variant's cost.
ModuleInfo.DOCUMENTS: The workspace's files (invoices, contracts, images) kept in one place.
ModuleInfo.QUOTES: Quotes for your customers, generated as PDFs from a template.
ModuleInfo.CALENDAR: A calendar with the workspace's events, linked to orders, projects or customers.
ModuleInfo.SOCIAL_METRICS: The workspace's Instagram, TikTok and YouTube metrics in one place.
ModuleInfo.PROJECTS: Your clients' projects with their tasks, deliveries and timelines.

Account.title: Account settings
Account.description: What belongs to the account rather than a workspace. Only the Owner sees it.
Account.archivedDescription: They don't show up on the home screen or in the menu. Restoring them brings back their data, address and modules.
Account.restoreError: The workspace couldn't be restored. Try again.
Account.emptyDescription: When you archive a workspace from its settings, it will show up here.
